notes.title: beta 2.0.12 update
notes.content: It hasn’t been updated for nearly a year. I’ve fixed some minor bugs, and a few new features are expected to be released in the coming months.

notes.title: Beta 2.0.11 update
notes.content:
1. Allowed to adjust the volume of Audio media (however, can only lower the volume)
2. Beats TTS can use a Audio media as source
3. Some small bug fix

notes.title: Beta 2.0.10 Update
notes.content:
A project backup mechanism has been added.
When saving the project, project file will be backed up to the "backup" folder within the project directory, facilitating the review of changes and preventing the loss of the project.

notes.title: Update beta 2.0.9
notes.content:
1. In the tab menu, when selecting media, you can label or group according to color labels, making it easier to manage.
2. When exporting or synthesizing voice, the project will be saved automatically.
3. Some other bug fix

notes.title: update beta 2.0.8
notes.content:
1. Updated the project's blank page header with a design inspired by the recently popular kawaii-style text logos.
2. Improved English localization, supplementing the speech synthesis lib with English and multilingual sources provided by MS Azure.
3. Optimized automatic line wrapping to better conform to language standards when punctuation marks appear at the beginning or end of a line.
4. [Major Update] Added a new type of media, "Sprite" which allows for a simple and effortless implementation of character animations that follow the mouth movements during speech!
5. Other minor adjustments and debugging have been made.

notes.title: Update beta 2.0.7
notes.content:
1. Allowed to created an empty intel project by leave the [logfile] entry empty.
2. Allowed to import media objects from workshop template to your project
3. The function of creating media button changed. now you can directly creating media object from selected file.
4. Now you can fix the preview of more than one media in the preview window. try ctrl+E
5. The name of export file is now more easy to understand.
6. Some other small bug fix.

notes.title: Workshop is now online!
notes.content:
[h1] Workshop is now online! [/h1]

In video production, a subtle interface design is very important, but this is often a problem for non-professional video producers.
RplGenStudio's Workshop is now online! Users can share their own preset templates in the workshop, or download templates shared by others.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2550090/workshop/

In the RplGenStudio's library page, click on Workshop to start browsing Workshop. Once you subscription is complete (an accelerator may be required), you can use the subscribed template directly when creating intel projects.

notes.title: RplGen Studio beta 2.0.6 update
notes.content:
1. Added Workshop support! Download new preset templates from Workshop is now supported!
2. Added the tab completion menu of [.(Subtype)] and [,(Next)] during script editing
3. Fixed several bugs, including:
 a. Rich text and <run> text effects are incorrectly displayed when used together
 b. Sometimes the main window cannot be reopened after being minimized
